description: 100-cruise fleet evaluation of surveillance modality ROI under realistic outbreak base rates. Tests whether wastewater/wearable surveillance reduces total fleet harm (infections + operational disruption) or increases it through false-positive-driven intervention costs.

base_rates.description: Per-cruise probability of each pathogen scenario. Must sum to 1.0. Based on CDC VSP MIDRS 2006-2019: ~1-2% of voyages have reportable AGE, with norovirus dominant.
sources: Jenkins et al. 2021 MMWR SS 70(6):1-19 — 127M passengers, 252 ships, 2006-2019

norovirus_subclinical.notes: High dose_adj = low transmission. Single case that usually fizzles.

norovirus_outbreak.notes: Multiple index cases, moderate transmission. ~5-20% expected AR.

status_quo.description: Current industry standard: syndromic surveillance + clinical RDT. No environmental or wearable monitoring.

wastewater_added.description: Status quo + wastewater sequencing grid. Enables SOP-004/005 (PPE on wastewater signal).

wearable_added.description: Status quo + wearable physiological monitoring. Enables SOP-012/013/014.

full_stack.description: All modalities active. Maximum detection sensitivity. Tests whether added sensitivity creates net benefit or net harm from false positives.

full_stack_relaxed_vsp.description: Full stack + relaxed VSP threshold (5% instead of 3%). Tests whether higher threshold offsets increased detection sensitivity.

primary.name: total_fleet_infections
primary.description: Sum of true infections across all 100 cruises

primary.name: total_fleet_ois
primary.description: Sum of OIS across all 100 cruises

primary.name: net_fleet_reward
primary.description: Sum of Presidio fleet rewards (combines infection + cost penalties)

secondary.name: false_positive_confinement_days
secondary.description: Agent-epochs of confinement for uninfected agents

secondary.name: detection_lead_time_outbreaks_only
secondary.description: Epochs from pathogen intro to first detection, averaged over actual outbreaks only

secondary.name: outbreak_final_ar
secondary.description: Attack rate in cruises with actual outbreaks

secondary.name: quiet_cruise_ois
secondary.description: OIS accumulated on cruises with NO outbreak — pure false-positive cost

policy_implications.name: ois_per_infection_prevented
policy_implications.description: Marginal OIS cost per infection prevented vs status quo

policy_implications.name: break_even_outbreak_rate
policy_implications.description: At what base rate of outbreaks does this surveillance regime break even on total fleet cost?

sensitivity_parameters.description: Parameters to sweep for sensitivity analysis

axes.name: base_rate_outbreak
axes.description: What if outbreaks are more common?

axes.name: ois_false_positive_multiplier
axes.description: How much worse is unnecessary intervention?
